name: Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints

facts.value: 1830 (continuing the original church). Centered at Salt Lake City from 1848

citations.locator: Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, group profile
citations.excerpt: This church was organized on April 6, 1830 in Fayette, New York, by Joseph Smith.
and since 1848 largely concentrated about Salt Lake City, Utah.

facts.value: The main body of Latter-day Saints, headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah.

citations.excerpt: The main body of Latter-day Saints is headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah, where the Salt Lake Temple and Tabernacle are located.
